entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, the name is Sam Jones, order number is VF886-012.
Thank you, Sam. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reader is junk. It claims my heart rate is jumping from 50 to 160 while I'm just sitting here reading. The thing is basically garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear about that trouble. That's definitely not the performance we expect. Our technical support team is excellent and can usually resolve that with a few quick troubleshooting steps. Would you be open to me transferring you?

Honestly, I don't have time to go through all of that. I've already tried restarting it and nothing changed. I don't want a replacement, I just want money back for a product that doesn't work. I'd like a refund.

I understand you'd prefer not to troubleshoot. Typically for a defect claim, we need to verify the issue with our tech team before we can authorize a return for a refund. It's just to confirm it's not a simple software fix.

I see your point, but from my perspective, I paid for a working device and I received a broken one. I'm not really interested in a negotiation to get it fixed, I just want my money back. What does your return policy say?
Of course. Let me just pull up the official policy for you. Please hold one moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting, Sam. I've checked our knowledge base and I see that our standard return policy allows for returns on all items within 90 days of delivery.
Looking at your delivery date, you received it 25 days ago, so you are well within that 90-day window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.
Oh, 90 days? Okay, that's great. So you can process the return now?

Yes. I've just processed the authorization. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at a post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Perfect, that's exactly what I needed. Thank you for making that easy, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
